composition_subtypes.role: binary search on number of operations
greedy assignment of minimal non-decreasing values

payload.core_composition_summary: Binary search over k operations; greedy check tries to assign each element a feasible value ≥ previous, picking the smallest possible.
payload.rationale: Combines binary search on answer with a greedy feasibility test, where the greedy choice is locally optimal and can be justified by an exchange argument.
